name: @comchatx/amazon-bedrock
description: Amazon Bedrock in pi, through the ComChatX box's model proxy.
author: ComChatX

description.en: In the AWS console, open Amazon Bedrock, go to API keys and generate a long-term API key, then paste it into this plugin's Settings. Its models then show under Models and in chat. A short-term API key lasts 12 hours at most, so it does not suit this plugin, and AWS access keys are not accepted.
description.zh: 在 AWS 控制台打开 Amazon Bedrock，在「API keys」中生成一个长期 API Key，粘贴到这个插件的「设置」里。之后它的模型会列在「模型」中，也能在对话中选用。短期 API Key 最多 12 小时就会失效，不适合这里；AWS 访问密钥不能用。
